name: Inutomo - Aka Inu Kanchi to Nakama-tachi
original_name: イヌトモ 赤犬カンチと仲間たち
source:
Kanchi is a very easy-going college student dog-beast. He has lots of fun every day with his childhood friend Higa, bright and cheerful classmate Klobe and energetic sempai Azuma.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
